desc.cn: 这张牌可以被视为任意花色。
desc.en: A card with this foil can be regarded as any suit.

desc.cn: 抽到这张牌时，获得5巫术金块，该牌失去附术·黄金。
desc.en: When drawing a card with this foil, remove the Geld foil from it, then gain Witchgeld +5.

desc.cn: 抽到这张牌时，可以选择丢弃这张牌。
desc.en: When drawing a card with this foil, you can choose to discard it.

desc.cn: 抽到这张牌时，该牌失去附术·王国，本轮点数上限＋3。
desc.en: When drawing a card with this foil, remove the Majesty foil from it, then grant Limit +3 (this round).
